Name: Sparkz's Overworld Tweaks
Author: sergalbutt
Description:
[b][u][size=5]A simple mod that makes a few simple changes[/size][/u][/b]

[list]
[*]Gives the trees a "trim" at the south west of the default farm for more visibility
[*]Adds another plank bridge across the water at the mountains, so you don't have to run all the way back around the top to get to the quarry
[*]Straightens the dirt path at the railroad, because why does it have that unnecessary deviation? 😅
[/list]

[i][size=4]If you've got any ideas for anything that would make a good addition to this mod, feel free to let me know![/size][/i]

Manifest.Name: Sparkz's Overworld Tweaks
Manifest.Description: Trims the trees at the south of the farm, adds an extra plank bridge to the mountains and straightens the path at the railroad.
Manifest.Author: sergalbutt
